A little about me

Learning, creating, and connecting ideas.

Curiosity into capability

I’m building my technical foundation one step at a time. I want to learn more, practise more, build real projects, and become someone who can use technology to solve meaningful problems. I’m comfortable being a beginner because every expert starts somewhere—and I’m ready to put in the work.

Art, leadership & technology

As a National Award-winning painter, I’ve learned patience, observation, and the value of refining small details. My involvement in student leadership, theatre, and event coordination helps me practise teamwork and communication—skills I want to bring into the tech world too.

A memorable experience at the iQOO Z11 launch

Grateful to have been invited to the iQOO Z11 launch event.

It was a fantastic opportunity to experience the energy of a product launch where technology, innovation, and a vibrant tech community came together.

What stood out most was getting to experience the product and the launch environment firsthand. Experiences like these offer a chance to step beyond the classroom, connect with people from the industry, and see how technology is introduced to the world.

A memorable experience—and one I’m glad to have been part of. ↗
